item.title: Apple Shrinks Dynamic Island on iPhone 18 Pro
item.description: REWA Technology’s teardown shows Apple’s hardware tweaks to shrink the Dynamic Island on the iPhone 18 Pro, including an under‑display camera and modem.

item.title: iPhone 18 Pro: Smaller Island, 3 Live Activities
item.description: Apple’s iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max introduce a smaller Dynamic Island that can show and toggle three Live Activities at once, boosting multitasking.
